SELECT
COUNT(*) AS todayOrderCount,
COALESCE( SUM( CASE WHEN status = 4 THEN total_amount ELSE 0 END ), 0 ) AS todayAmount,
SUM( CASE WHEN order_type = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS todayDineInCount,
SUM( CASE WHEN order_type = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS todayTakeoutCount,
SUM( CASE WHEN status IN (1, 2, 3) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS pendingOrderCount,
SUM( CASE WHEN status = 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS completedOrderCount
FROM orders
WHERE DATE(create_time) = CURDATE()

SELECT
dish_id AS dishId,
dish_name AS dishName,
SUM(quantity) AS quantity,
dish_price AS price
FROM order_detail
WHERE order_id IN (
SELECT id
FROM orders
WHERE DATE(create_time) = CURDATE() AND status = 4
)
GROUP BY dish_id, dish_name,dish_price
ORDER BY quantity DESC
LIMIT 5

SELECT
DATE_FORMAT( MIN(create_time), '%H:00' ) AS time,
COUNT(*) AS orderCount,
COALESCE( SUM( CASE WHEN status = 4 THEN total_amount ELSE 0 END ), 0 ) AS amount
FROM orders
WHERE DATE(create_time) = CURDATE()
GROUP BY HOUR(create_time)
ORDER BY HOUR(create_time)
